task.name: ODE integration: Discretized Heat Equation N=20
task.description: Local ODE integration: Discretized Heat Equation N=20 task with the primary-source relationship and evaluation changes specified in its protocol notes. A2DEPT https://arxiv.org/html/2604.24043v1 Appendix G.1 and Table 17 explicitly include the harmonic oscillator and N=20 discretized heat equation. This local evaluator uses its documented initial conditions and time intervals, tight SciPy reference integration, terminal relative error and -log10(error)-0.5*log10(RHS calls). It does not enforce the paper's fixed dt=0.05 versus adaptive rtol=1e-5 comparison, aggregate all four source ODE families, or reproduce source trajectories/runtime results.
task.contract: integrate(f, t_span, y0) -> y(t_end) for an initial-value problem y' = f(t, y); the evaluator counts calls to f. Score: -log10(relative error) - 0.5 * log10(evaluations)
